doc.tool: Plan (curobo) and move one arm's EEF to a world-frame xyz and wxyz orientation (default: keep current). The planned qpos waypoints are executed from fresh state. EEF is not TCP: do not send a raw object surface point.
doc.code:
Plan (cuRobo) and move one arm's eef to a world xyz and wxyz orientation (default: keep); the planned qpos waypoints run from the fresh state. EEF is not TCP. Returns the motion report: completed, requested_steps, executed_steps, stop_reason (native_success, budget_exhausted, cancelled, completed, runtime_failure or plan_failed), info (robot_state, episode_status, executed_actions), plan_status, waypoints, final_eef_xyz and final_dist_m.

Example:
    r = move_to("left", [-0.2, -0.05, 0.95])
    print(r["stop_reason"], r["final_dist_m"])

Example:

The joint state qpos (measured) and qpos_target (commanded), each 14 [left joints6, left gripper, right joints6, right gripper], and the eef16 state [left pose7 (xyz, wxyz), left gripper, right pose7, right gripper]; grippers 0 closed .. 1 open.

Example:
    st = get_state()
    print(st["qpos_target"], st["state"][:3])  # left eef xyz

Solve inverse kinematics for one arm's eef: the end of cuRobo's collision-checked path to the pose from the current joints (RoboTwin exposes its planner, not a bare IK solver). Raises when there is none.

Returns:
    joints: 6 joint angles.

Example:
    q = solve_ik([-0.2, -0.05, 0.95], [0, 0.707, 0, 0.707], "left")
    move_to_joints(q, "left")

gripper.description: Gripper value too, 0 closed .. 1 open (default: keep)

doc.code:
Move one arm to a joint configuration (one native qpos action; RoboTwin runs the motion). Returns the motion report: completed, requested_steps, executed_steps, stop_reason (native_success, budget_exhausted, cancelled, completed, runtime_failure or plan_failed), info (robot_state, episode_status, executed_actions) and final_joints.

Example:
    move_to_joints([0.0, 1.2, 1.0, 0.0, -0.5, 0.0], "right")

start_pose_wxyz_xyz.description: Start pose, wxyz then xyz: the arm's current eef pose (cuRobo plans from the current joints)

doc.code:
Plan joint waypoints [N, 6] between two eef poses with cuRobo (collision-aware). The start must be the arm's current eef pose. Raises when planning fails.

Example:
    p = get_state()["state"][:7]  # left eef: xyz, wxyz
    start = list(p[3:]) + list(p[:3])
    traj = traj_plan(start, [0, 0.707, 0, 0.707, -0.2, -0.05, 0.95], "left")
    move_along_trajectory(traj[::4], "left")

gripper.description: Gripper command held along the path, 0 closed .. 1 open; omit to keep it

doc.code:
Move one arm along joint-space waypoints, one native qpos action each. Returns the motion report: completed, requested_steps, executed_steps, stop_reason (native_success, budget_exhausted, cancelled, completed, runtime_failure or plan_failed), info (robot_state, episode_status, executed_actions) and final_joints.

Example:
    move_along_trajectory(traj, "left")

The raw joint and eef16 state (get_state's, for the raw tier): qpos (measured) and qpos_target (commanded), each 14 [left joints6, left gripper, right joints6, right gripper], and state [left pose7 (xyz, wxyz), left gripper, right pose7, right gripper].

Example:
    q = list(raw_obs()["qpos_target"])

action_type.description: 'qpos' (14 joints, default) or 'ee' (16: two 7-D poses and grippers)

doc.code:
One native action of both arms.

Example:
    q = list(raw_obs()["qpos_target"])
    q[13] = 0.0  # close the right gripper (0 closed .. 1 open)
    r = step(q)
    print(r["info"]["robot_state"]["right_gripper"], r["info"]["episode_status"]["eval_success"])

actions.description: N x 14 or N x 16 floats

action_type.description: 'qpos' (14 joints, default) or 'ee' (16: two 7-D poses and grippers)

doc.code:
Run N native actions in one call.

Example:
    q = list(raw_obs()["qpos_target"])
    rows = [q[:13] + [c] for c in (0.8, 0.5, 0.2, 0.0)]  # close the right gripper in 4 actions
    r = chunk_step(rows)
    print(r["info"]["executed_actions"], r["info"]["robot_state"]["right_gripper"])
